verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents opening custom ports with docker -p arguments and creates a Cloudflare tunnel for each open port, so applications can be served from an instance. It also documents overlay networks that give instances a private virtual LAN with direct communication on all ports. missing for 10: private overlay networking is limited to instances on machines in the same physical LAN; no detailed docs on port mapping or how serving behaves through direct ports versus tunnels; no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: You can open custom ports for any docker image using -p arguments in the docker create/run options box in the image config editor pop-up menu.
a secure Cloudflare tunnel will be created for each of your instance's open ports
Vast now supports creating *overlay* networks for instances, allowing client instances on different machines on the same physical LAN to share a private, virtual LAN
This allows direct communication between the instances on all ports, which is expected by NCCL.
